reason: The excavator can prepare the marked area for a stable industrial site.
expectation: The excavator should clear or level the fuel-fab site.

effect: The leveled footing completes the site preparation; the next task is to add power.
reaction: The broad footing is a sensible foundation for the equipment.
reason: The spare solar modules appear intended to supply the fuel-fab area with power.
expectation: The modules will be installed at the prepared site to provide industrial power.

effect: The spare modules now supply a separate industrial circuit, completing the chapter while preserving power for the growing room.
reaction: The separate circuit is a satisfying, physically sensible detail, though the propellant equipment remains for later.

mostWorthwhile.text: Installing the solar modules was most worthwhile: it connected the return plan to a concrete power supply without taking the growing room's allotted power.

leastWorthwhile.text: Preparing the footing was straightforward and predictable, though its broad, stable base made practical sense.

surprise.text: The chapter ended after establishing industrial power, before any propellant-making equipment was built.

arbitrary.text: Neither action felt arbitrary; both followed directly from the stated goals and available equipment.

continue.text: Yes. I would choose to see how the industrial supply becomes a propellant system and how the discovery reaches Earth, although this short chapter offered few decisions.
